title: Terrain Preset
description: How a Battlefield is generated: two noise fields, elevation and moisture, each ranked so a threshold is a share of the map's cells.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

frequency.description: Noise cycles across the map's width in the first octave.

octaves.description: Each doubles the frequency of the last.

persistence.description: Each octave's amplitude relative to the last.

bands.description: Elevation bands, lowest first. Each covers elevation up to `upTo`; the last must reach 1.

height.description: Height level: high ground and extra Sight.

terrains.description: Terrains by moisture, driest first. Each covers moisture up to `upTo`; the last must reach 1.

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: What the generator turns blocked cells into when it cuts a path to connect the map.
